title: Longest common prefix of many by sorting
statementMd:
Return the longest common prefix of a non-empty list by comparing only the lexicographically smallest and largest word.

**Example:** `common_prefix_sorted(["flower", "flow", "flight"])` returns `"fl"`.
hints: After sorting only the extremes matter.
solutionMd:
```python
def common_prefix_sorted(words):
    a, b = min(words), max(words)
    i = 0
    while i < len(a) and i < len(b) and a[i] == b[i]:
        i += 1
    return a[:i]
```

The prefix of the extremes is shared by everything between.
